cases.invariant: A pending address is shown only in the info alert, with the theme icon, and the resend action reaches the container once
cases.actor: Signed-in user-937 with a pending address
cases.input: pendingEmail pending-937@example.test, sending false, one click on resend
cases.response: the info alert contains the address; its icon SVG has width and height 20; onResend called once
forbiddenEffects: the pending address rendered outside the alert
onResend called more than once per click
cases.testName: CabinetEmailChangeSectionView (Task 937) [SEC-937-FE-PENDING-ALLOW] a pending address shows only in the info alert with the theme icon and resend reaches the container once

cases.invariant: No second resend request while one is in flight
cases.actor: Signed-in user-937 with a resend in flight
cases.input: pendingEmail set, sending true, click on the resend action
cases.response: the resend action is disabled and shows the loading label; onResend is not called
forbiddenEffects: an enabled resend action while sending
cases.testName: CabinetEmailChangeSectionView (Task 937) [SEC-937-FE-RESEND-DENY] while a resend is in flight the action is disabled and a click calls nothing

cases.invariant: A refusal is announced as an alert with exactly the container's localized text
cases.actor: Signed-in user-937 whose resend was refused
cases.input: error 'Too many requests. Try again later.' with a pending address
cases.response: one role=alert element whose text equals the given error
forbiddenEffects: the error rendered without role alert
any other text added to the error
cases.testName: CabinetEmailChangeSectionView (Task 937) [SEC-937-FE-ERROR] a refusal renders as an alert with exactly the container's text

cases.invariant: A resend retires only the session user's earlier links and stores one new link for that user

cases.response: the retire update is filtered by user_id user-937 and consumed_at null; one new token row for user-937; the mail sender called once for the pending address; result without error
forbiddenEffects: a retire update without the user_id filter
a token stored for another user
cases.testName: resendEmailVerification (Task 937) [SEC-937-SRV-RESEND-ALLOW] a resend retires only the session user's links and stores one new link for that user
